result.title: Spatially Gated Demographic Steering for Debiasing Multi-Person Text-to-Image Generation
result.summary: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene. In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image. Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline. Text- and latent-projection approaches shift the aggregate skew with only marginal gains in intra-image diversity. We present Spatially Gated Steering (SGS), which steers the demographics of each person independently by extracting per-person masks from the Diffusion Transformer's (DiT) internal attention maps at a critical denoising timestep and applying a distinct demographic vector within each mask for the remaining steps. SGS needs no fine-tuning, inversion or layout specifications, and uses a lightweight segmentor over frozen DiT attention features to localize subjects at early timesteps. On skewed occupational prompts, SGS reaches high intra-image racial and gender diversity while keeping aggregate balance competitive and image quality near baseline, a result we validate on two architecturally distinct diffusion transformers, FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large. Codebase and model weights are available at https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Spatially Gated Steering：在关键去噪步从 DiT 内部注意力图提取逐人掩码，并在后续步骤对每个掩码区域施加不同的人群向量，无需微调、反演或布局输入，以在多人物文生图中兼顾图内多样性与整体人口均衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用冻结 DiT 注意力特征定位实体、再在掩码区域内做差异化 latent 干预的做法，可能为 LVR 中依据注意力结构筛选视觉证据和局部化内部状态修改提供线索，掩码质量与时序稳定性可供核查。
